# Briefly — AI Smart Ingestion & Contract/Invoice Audit Hub

Briefly is a enterprise B2B document processing platform. It ingests unstructured documents (invoices, receipts, supplier contracts), extracts data with structured JSON schemas, and performs deterministic validation (NIF checksums, tax calculation, chronological sequence).

## Main Features
- Document Processing: Scanned PDFs & Scanned Images -> Structured JSON
- Tax Validation: Portuguese NIF/VAT Modulo 11 Checksum Verification
- Business Audit Engine: Mathematical balance reconciliation (Subtotal + VAT = Total, Qty * Price = Line Amount)
- Interactive Hub: Split-screen document viewer & live reconciliation workspace
- API Endpoint: /api/ingest for automated document processing pipelines

## Tech Stack
- Next.js 15 App Router
- TypeScript (Strict Mode)
- Google Gemini API (Structured Outputs)
- Zod Schema Validation
- Vitest & MSW Integration Testing
